title: Bronze Rewards Card: When and How Are Cash Back Rewards Paid?
summary: Explains Bronze Rewards Card cash back payout timing: rewards accrue at 1.0% when eligible purchases post (pending transactions don’t). You can redeem when available rewards reach at least $17; most redemptions process within a few business days, and near statement closing may show next cycle. Includes partial redemptions and how returns can reduce available rewards.
